_comment: Cream floral kurti, matched to the reference video: semi-fitted straight silhouette with slight A-line, mandarin collar, 3/4 fitted sleeves, side slits from the hip, straight hem. All measurements are Blender metres on a ~1.65m figure. Values are HALF-widths (radii), not full widths.
name: kurti_01

body._depth_ratio: front-back squash; a torso is an ellipse, not a circle

widths._at: normalised height up the garment: 0 = hem, 1 = shoulder

sleeves._outward: how far the sleeve eases away from the body as it descends. Keep small — arms hang down, they do not stick out sideways.

side_slit._start_height: normalised: 0.34 = just below the hip, matching the reference

drape._comment: Three fold scales layered: macro drape, medium pleats, micro wrinkles. Amplitude scales toward the hem (gravity_bias) because fabric hangs looser the further it falls from the shoulder.

material._color_note: base_tint is LINEAR, not sRGB. Blender converts linear->sRGB on display, so entering sRGB hex values directly renders washed out.
